recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future lifecycle changes should be handled as resource-specific tracker items when a work group wants to change a particular status value set or entered-in-error mechanism.
issue_request: FHIR-7448 was a Published FHIR-core/MnM DSTU1 change request with a Persuasive with Modification resolution. It asked to improve lifecycle table generation, add a generation hint, and make missing entered-in-error handling part of QA criteria because too many rows said Unknown - not stated by committee.
initial_application: The issue was applied by svn revision 5535, preserved as git commit da3856859e16179bd5c47577e86dd68e2dda2bcf, which added entered-in-error inference and hint logic to ResourceValidator and linked generated lifecycle table resource names. The Jira comments also cite svn revision 5935, preserved as git commit 5afc2790463eed7e4191e9ce13d5369b29b89537, which added the note for resources omitted from the entered-in-error table.
additional_context: Current source/lifecycle.html uses generated status-code lists and an enteredInErrorTable placeholder, and the current CI-rendered lifecycle page expands these into explicit lifecycle examples and a resource/status table. Later Published issue FHIR-32152 refined lifecycle examples by adding Appointment.status, without reversing the FHIR-7448 approach.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No current core source edit is needed because the historical generator/QA changes and current lifecycle source/rendering already address the issue request.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue that expanded lifecycle page examples and confirms continued lifecycle page maintenance without reopening FHIR-7448's automated-generation request.
